title: Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation

paragraphs: This Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation reviews ownership, corporate structure, brand and operator relationships, people, portfolio context, and development implications for voco Cancún Zona Hotelera. Evidence is compiled from the completed Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation and supporting public sources.

Brand resolution: Same physical asset formerly traded as Real Inn Cancun. Current brand is voco (IHG). Current marketed property name is voco Cancún Zona Hotelera (IHG hoteldetail CUNCN). Former brand Real Inn CONFIRMED.
Current operator reading: Aimbridge LATAM (CURRENT; HIGH). Former operator: Hoteles Camino Real / Grupo Real Turismo.
Property company / title vehicle: not verified from reviewed public sources. Economic / package owner reading: Alliance Hotel Management / Alliance Hospitality Management LLC.
Six-hotel Alliance → Aimbridge → IHG voco conversion with named public owner and clear former Real Inn/Camino Real path — Mexico Explorer reflag archetype.

Material open questions remain (13) — including deed/title, decision authority, brand/operator contracts, and capital structure where not established. Unresolved items are listed explicitly rather than inferred.

Methodology: owner ≠ operator ≠ brand. Titles are not signing authority. Findings are research-grade and are not auto-applied to master property records. This dossier is the primary Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation for the hotel.

paragraphs: This chapter establishes the focus hotel for the Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation and guards against adjacent-asset confusion in the same market corridor.
Focus hotel: voco Cancún Zona Hotelera (f/k/a Real Inn Cancun) — same physical asset (reflag), Km 5.5 Blvd. Kukulcan, Zona Hotelera, Cancún.
Current marketed property name is voco Cancún Zona Hotelera (IHG). Brand is voco. Former trading name Real Inn Cancun. Not a separate nearby hotel.

Published address evidence supports Km 5.5, Blvd. Kukulcan, Zona Hotelera, Cancún, Quintana Roo 77500, Mexico (First-party/OTA sources support Km 5.5; Dealality note showing Km 9 appears inconsistent with cited sources.).
Room inventory is assessed at 160 rooms/suites with HIGH confidence (IHG / trade coverage for conversion portfolio).
Product posture: Upper midscale / Hotel Zone conversion — IHG voco — current marketed identity on IHG hoteldetail (CUNCN); formerly Real Inn Cancun.
Primary public web channel: https://www.ihg.com/voco/hotels/us/en/cancun/cuncn/hoteldetail.
Prior recorded affiliation is preserved as evidence context only and is not silently overwritten when research shows a FORMER or ANNOUNCED brand posture.

paragraphs: Ownership diligence separates the hotel asset, PropCo / title vehicle, economic owner or package owner, sponsor principals, and natural-person UBO. Operator and brand are not treated as ownership.
PROPCO: Not verified — status UNKNOWN. Mexican title-holding PropCo / fideicomiso not obtained from Quintana Roo registry in this pass.

ECONOMIC OWNER: Alliance Hotel Management / Alliance Hospitality Management LLC — status HIGH. Publicly named owner of the six-hotel Mexico portfolio including Cancún (IHG/trade coverage). Deed-level Mexican vehicle still unknown.
SPONSOR PRINCIPALS: Miguel Justo & Carlos Justo — status PROBABLE. Mexican press names brothers as buyers of six Real Inn hotels including Cancún (May 2025). Exact legal bridge to Alliance UNKNOWN.
FORMER OWNER: Grupo Vazol / Grupo Camino Real side (Olegario Vázquez Aldir) — status FORMER. Reported seller of six named Real Inn hotels including Cancún.

For Real Inn Cancun / voco Cancún Zona Hotelera, Alliance Hotel Management is the publicly named package owner across IHG and trade coverage, while the Mexican title-holding PropCo / fideicomiso remains UNKNOWN from Quintana Roo registry extracts in this pass.
Natural-person UBO is not asserted. Probable sponsor or buyer principals are labeled PROBABLE where press names exist without registry confirmation.
